matters.title: Award of Contract for the Purchase of Motorola Two-way Radios through the State of Texas HGACBuy Program.
matters.text: Requesting to purchase New APX N30 Motorola Radios to replace discontinued XTS Radios in use by the Parks and Planning Departments (Project No. 01-24-P83-01).

attachments.name: Memo
attachments.text:
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
MEMORANDUM
To: Roel “Roy” Rodriguez, P.E., City Manager
Through: Jeff Johnston, Assistant City Manager
From: Robert Acosta, Information Technology Director
Date: January 11, 2024
Subject: Award contract for the Purchase of Motorola Two-Way Radios through the State of
Texas HGACBuy Program
GOAL:
Requesting to purchase New APX N30 Motorola Radios to replace discontinued XTS Radios in use by
the Parks and Planning Departments.
BRIEF EXPLANATION:
Parks and Planning Departments are using two-way radios that have been designated as end of life. Their
XTS radios have been discontinued and are no longer being supported by Motorola. In addition,
replacement parts such as batteries, antennas, chargers...etc. have become hard to find.
RECOMMENDATION:
Staff recommends approval of the Purchase of replacement two-way radios from Motorola Solutions
under the State of Texas HGACBuy Program for a total cost of $111.979.97. Contract: 17724 - HGAC
(TX)-RA05-21.
